Public memory enforced accountability by refusing to allow staged PR photos to sanitize documented history, proving transparency cannot be bypassed by marketing.

Noem framed the post as a standard seasonal cultural greeting (WHAT), but audiences recognized a calculated attempt to repair her image after past cruelty (WHO), rejecting the bait-and-switch.

When political actors use animals as props to project wholesome authenticity (Justification), they run a Smart Selfish Loop. When past actions contradict the pretext, the attempted extraction of moral capital collapses into immediate public cynicism.

The Unavoidable Lie: Cultural hunting traditions can be weaponized as an instant PR scrubbing mechanism.

Actual Article Body:
Social media users on X ripped former Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem after she posted a picture with her dog for the start of pheasant hunting season in South Dakota.

“Happy Opener, South Dakota! Foster and I wish you good luck in the field! Pheasant hunting is part of who we are, and it’s a tradition worth passing on to our kids and grandkids,” Noem said on X Saturday.
